fact: Tynon 说一百年前 Greenwrack 还有许多人居住，如今天然堤道无人维护，整片沼泽已成死亡陷阱。
anchor: A hundred years ago, perhaps, when many people still lived here

fact: Crows 决定在 Greenwrack 大部分地段弃马步行，只留少数马匹驮行李、必要时把人从泥坑里拉出来。
anchor: So we must set them free. We will keep a few to carry baggage

fact: Flann 的全名是 Flannery Alderwood，Mearna 说只有多年老友才敢这样叫他，并当场戳穿他自称熟悉此地的话。
anchor: You are a terrible liar, Flannery Alderwood,” said Mearna, not without fondness

fact: Vedra 提议把 Daley 手上的 Amber 交给昏迷的 Xaniko，自己用龙晶 Witness 经 Dream Road 求他指路。
anchor: Daley still has the Amber. And I still have Xaniko’s dragonglass Witness.

fact: Olant 等三名草甸雇佣兵说奉命带 Tace Alastar 去山谷，实际却押着他走向俯瞰 Silverway 的崖顶。
anchor: they seemed to be taking Alastar in quite the wrong direction

fact: 一队佩戴 Latterban 蓝鹰徽的骑兵冲进营地（众人推测是 Tace 之子 Aidan 的人），把 Alastar 从雇佣兵手里带走并护送回帐。
anchor: they all wore the Blue Eagle of Latterban

fact: 在 Dream Road 上，Xaniko 的幽影把 Vedra 当成他从未见过面的孙女 Ela，并提起妻子 Ona。
anchor: You never saw Ravensperch. And you never knew your grandmother, Ona

fact: Vedra 顺势以“Grandfather”相称，骗出穿越沼泽的路线，事后自认更像个贼而不是救星。
anchor: We are trapped in the Greenwrack, Grandfather, and we are being chased by bad men
